newsitem.title: USA: Rehabilicare gets FDA approval for product.
newsitem.headline: Rehabilicare gets FDA approval for product.

text.p: Rehabilicare Inc said Monday it received clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market its Ortho Dx Electrotherapy System, a product used in knee implant surgeries.

"The Ortho Dx is a tremendous product aimed at a very large market," said David Kaysen, president and chief exeuctive. "There are approximately 350,000 knee surgeries involving anterior cruciate ligament repairs per year and 230,000 knee implant surgical procedures per year. These two procedures represent a market potential of over $350 million per year for the Ortho Dx."

"Given the market size for the Ortho Dx and the uniqueness of the product, we expect the Ortho Dx to make a significant contribution to our business in fiscal 1998," Kaysen said. "Introduction of the Ortho Dx, including sales force training and marketing efforts, will begin immediately. In addition, we are preparing a clinical study of the Ortho Dx in order to verify the efficacy and cost savings of the unique system."
